page0.text:
"..."
I restrain my body that wants to jump out.
I see Tohsaka biting her lips in the corner of my eye.

page1.text:
...I know.
It's obvious Tohsaka wants to stop him as well.
But, we'll be the ones killed if we do so.
There's no way we can stop him.

page2.text: The man's arm reaches out to the girl in white.

page3.text:
"..., ..., ..."
I can't breathe.
My feet are on fire from wanting to jump out,
and my arms want to fly out over the terrace.
My body... My body is shaking like it's broken and tries to go against my brain's orders.

page4.text: It's as if my heart is shattered.

page5.text:
"..., ..., ..."
Even then, I suppress my voice and kill my will.
I let the girl die as if killing myself.

page6.text:
...
And it ends.
The man pulled something out of the girl's body with his bare hands, with a smile still on his face.
A red, dripping object that looks like a fruit.
The thing in the man's hand is, without a doubt, the girl in white's -----.

page7.text:
...
My mind burns down.
The mind that has gone white is making my whole body shake with uncontrollable anger.
